mapper.select: SELECT res_id FROM gc_master_message WHERE user_id = #{studentId} AND target_user_id = #{userId} AND master_id = #{masterId} AND event_type = ${@com.threeatom.guidecore.constant.MessageEventType@VIDEO_2} ORDER BY update_time DESC

SELECT s.sub_id,COUNT(mm.id) AS nums FROM gc_master_message AS mm LEFT JOIN gc_user_event_resource AS ue ON ue.id= mm.res_id inner JOIN gc_event AS e ON ue.event_id=e.id LEFT JOIN gc_video AS v ON e.video_id=v.id LEFT JOIN courses s ON s.id=v.sub_id WHERE mm.target_user_id = #{userId} AND mm.master_id = #{masterId} AND mm.read_state = 0 AND mm.event_type!=${@com.threeatom.guidecore.constant.MessageEventType@QUESTION_5}
GROUP BY s.sub_id

SELECT mm.user_id,mm.event_type,uer.content,ua.answer_json,ua.event_id as answer_event_id,uer.event_id as er_event_id FROM gc_master_message AS mm LEFT JOIN gc_user_answer ua ON ( mm.event_type = ${@com.threeatom.guidecore.constant.MessageEventType@QUESTION_5} AND mm.user_answer_id = ua.id )
LEFT JOIN gc_user_event_resource uer ON ( mm.event_type in ( ${@com.threeatom.guidecore.constant.MessageEventType@notQuestion} ) AND mm.res_id = uer.id ) WHERE mm.id IN
(0)
#{messageId}

SELECT mm.id AS message_id,s.id AS child_sub_id,s.sub_id AS sub_id FROM gc_master_message AS mm LEFT JOIN gc_user_event_resource AS uer ON mm.res_id = uer.id LEFT JOIN gc_event AS e ON e.id = uer.event_id LEFT JOIN gc_video AS v ON v.id = e.video_id LEFT JOIN courses AS s ON s.id = v.sub_id WHERE mm.master_id = #{masterId} AND mm.event_type != ${@com.threeatom.guidecore.constant.MessageEventType@QUESTION_5} AND mm.user_id = #{userId} AND mm.target_user_id = #{targetUserId} AND mm.read_state = 0 AND s.id != ""

select count(0) FROM gc_video_comment AS gvc LEFT JOIN gc_user AS u ON u.id = gvc.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_file AS f2 ON f2.id = gvc.file_id LEFT JOIN gc_master_message AS m ON m.video_comment_id = gvc.id LEFT JOIN gc_video AS gv ON gv.id = gvc.video_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info ui ON ui.id = u.info_id LEFT JOIN sys_file AS f ON ui.avatar_file_id = f.id left join gc_video_comment g2 on g2.id = gvc.reply_comment_id left join sys_file as f3 on f3.id = g2.file_id where m.master_id=#{masterId} and m.target_user_id = #{thisUserId}
and m.read_state = #{readState}

SELECT count(0) FROM gc_user_note_comment AS unc LEFT JOIN gc_user AS u ON u.id = unc.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_file AS f2 ON f2.id = unc.file_id LEFT JOIN gc_master_message AS m ON m.user_note_comment_id = unc.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info ui ON ui.id = u.info_id LEFT JOIN sys_file AS f ON ui.avatar_file_id = f.id LEFT JOIN gc_event AS e ON e.id = unc.event_id WHERE m.master_id = #{masterId} and m.target_user_id = #{thisUserId}
and m.read_state = #{readState}
